comparison.objective: Sort glasses and plates into separate receptacles, stack plates largest-first, and hand every item across the midline.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated bimanual handoffs, upright placement, and ordered stacking versus fine tool insertion and mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct receptacles and stable size-ordered stack with no tips or drops versus repeatable force- and travel-bounded carriage stops.
comparison.reason: This tests cross-body logistics and stacking constraints rather than commissioning. No spec versions or detailed numeric placement tolerances are provided, but the objective is clearly unrelated.
